crossRefs.note: Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.
He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.
You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.
He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.
He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.
Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and Yahweh caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all night, and…

But the children of Israel walked on dry land in the middle of the sea, and the waters were a wall to them on their…

Who led them through the depths, like a horse in the wilderness, so that they didn’t stumble?
By faith, they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.
